name: powerplug-icon-carousel
description: Looping icon carousel for the Ring AIR Powerplugs hero. Centre icon is larger, the row advances one slot at a time through a full 8-step cycle, and each icon has an Apple-style rim-light shimmer.
usage: Save the 'html' value to a file named carousel.html and open it, or paste it into Figma Make or any web view.
Add ?bg=dark or ?bg=transparent to the URL to change the background. White is the default.
To change icons, replace the data URIs in the ICONS array inside the html and edit ITEMS to set the order.
Tune any number from the 'spec' block by editing the CFG object in the html.

layout.offsetFormula: x(d) = sign(d) * (|d| <= 1 ? 99*|d| : 99 + 90*(|d|-1)), measured from the carousel centre
layout.note: d is the signed distance from the centre in slots, fractional while moving. Icons with |d| > 3 are hidden.

rimShimmer.technique: conic-gradient ring masked to the outline, plus a soft-light radial sheen
rimShimmer.tiltInput: DeviceOrientation gamma on phones, pointer x over the carousel on desktop (about +/-70deg)

spec.reducedMotion: no autoplay, no drift, no sweep
